biggest_catch: Per-referral payout varies by product tier: $50 for bundled checking+savings, Summit Savings, or business accounts; $100 for Axos Checking or personal loan. The friend must use your unique referral link and meet product-specific requirements (e.g., $1,500 in direct deposit funding within 90 days for bundled checking+savings).
catches: Payout varies by product: $50 (bundled checking+savings, Summit Savings, business accounts) vs $100 (Axos Checking, personal loan); mortgage referrals pay only the friend ($500 toward closing costs) with no advocate reward.
Friend must use the unique referral link; cannot earn a bonus for referring yourself.
Bundled checking+savings: friend must complete $1,500 in direct deposit funding within 90 days of account opening.
Business referrals: $3,000 maintained for 90 days (checking) or $30,000 maintained for 90 days (savings).
Bonus deposited within 21 days of the statement cycle end once requirements are met (30 days for business referrals).
No tax disclosure stated on the referral page.

steps: Log in to Axos Bank online banking or the Axos app and get your unique Share Axos referral link.
Share the link with friends or businesses.
The referred person uses your link to open a qualifying account or apply for a loan.
The referred person meets the product-specific requirements (e.g., $1,500 in direct deposit funding within 90 days for bundled checking+savings).
Bonus is deposited to your account within 21 days of the statement cycle end once requirements are met (30 days for business referrals).
timing: Reward deposited within 21 days of the statement cycle end once the referred friend meets all eligibility requirements (30 days for business referrals).
when_cash_arrives: Reward deposited within 21 days of the statement cycle end once the referred friend meets all eligibility requirements (30 days for business referrals). Roughly a month from the trigger event to cash in hand.
maximize: Trigger the clock early: have your friend complete qualifying activity (direct deposit, debit transactions) in the first days of the window.
Route a real payroll direct deposit (not Zelle/P2P transfers, which most programs exclude) as early as possible - payroll timing is usually the gating step.
If any-amount direct deposit qualifies, a small recurring ACH can trigger it - check the program's 'qualifying deposit' definition first.
Structural reason it cannot be faster: the payout window itself is 3-4 weeks after qualification - there is no expedited track.
